name: _grid-overlay.scss
html:
// ─── Design Grid Overlay ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Activated by `html.show-grid` class (toggled from Preferences → Show Grid).
//
// Renders two layers:
//  1. ::before — outer gutter shading (left + right side of max-area)
//  2. a CSS grid-based column guide injected via CSS custom properties
//
// RULES:
//  - pointer-events: none on all pseudo-elements — non-interactive
//  - z-index: var(--z-overlay) — above content, below HUD/modals
//  - rgba(255,255,255,...) is ALLOWED for overlays per AGENTS.md shadow exception
//  - rgba($cms-accent-rgb,...) approximated via rgba() — accent column tint

@import 'variables';
@import 'mixins';
//  - No hardcoded dimensions — all sizes from $gap-* and $grid-max-area-* tokens
//
// Breakpoints/gutters come from the shared $grid-steps map (the same table
// %MAXAREA uses for content padding) via the `grid-steps` mixin — the overlay
// is correct at every viewport by construction, not by a hand-synced list.

// Translucent overlays need rgb channels + alpha — SCSS rgba() derives the
// channels from the color TOKENS (base files may hold $ vars), so there are
// no literal channel values anywhere.
$_col-fill: rgba($cms-accent, 0.08); // column highlight — accent tint
$_col-gap: rgba($color-black, 0); // gutter between columns — transparent
$_outer-fill: rgba($color-white, 0.05); // outer gutter shading
$_boundary: rgba($cms-accent, 0.35); // boundary line colour — accent

html.show-grid {
  // ── CSS custom props per breakpoint — drive both pseudo-elements ───────────
  --_grid-gutter: #{to-rem($gap-272)};
  --_grid-cols: #{map-get($grid-cols, 272)};
  --_grid-col-gap: #{to-rem($space-md)};

  // One media query per $grid-steps entry (272 is the unprefixed default).
  @include grid-steps() using ($step, $gap, $cols) {
    --_grid-gutter: #{to-rem($gap)};
    --_grid-cols: #{$cols};
  }

  // ── Outer gutter shade + column guides ────────────────────────────────────
  &::before {
    content: '';
    position: fixed;
    inset: 0;
    z-index: var(--z-overlay);
    pointer-events: none;

    // Column guides rendered as repeating-linear-gradient inside the max-area.
    // Each "tile" = one column width + one gap.
    // Outer gutters are shaded on the sides.
    background:
      // Left gutter shade
      linear-gradient(to right, $_outer-fill var(--_grid-gutter), transparent var(--_grid-gutter)),
      // Right gutter shade
      linear-gradient(to left, $_outer-fill var(--_grid-gutter), transparent var(--_grid-gutter)),
      // Column fill stripes repeating across the full width
      repeating-linear-gradient(
          to right,
          $_col-fill 0,
          $_col-fill
            calc(
              (100% - var(--_grid-gutter) * 2 - var(--_grid-col-gap) * (var(--_grid-cols) - 1)) /
                var(--_grid-cols)
            ),
          $_col-gap
            calc(
              (100% - var(--_grid-gutter) * 2 - var(--_grid-col-gap) * (var(--_grid-cols) - 1)) /
                var(--_grid-cols)
            ),
          $_col-gap
            calc(
              (100% - var(--_grid-gutter) * 2 - var(--_grid-col-gap) * (var(--_grid-cols) - 1)) /
                var(--_grid-cols) + var(--_grid-col-gap)
            )
        );

    background-repeat: no-repeat, no-repeat, repeat-x;
    background-position:
      left,
      right,
      var(--_grid-gutter) 0;
    background-size:
      auto,
      auto,
      calc(100% - var(--_grid-gutter) * 2) 100%;
  }

  // ── Max-area boundary hairlines ───────────────────────────────────────────
  &::after {
    content: '';
    position: fixed;
    inset: 0;
    z-index: var(--z-overlay);
    pointer-events: none;

    // Left and right boundary lines at the gutter edge
    background:
      linear-gradient(
        to right,
        transparent calc(var(--_grid-gutter) - 1px),
        $_boundary calc(var(--_grid-gutter) - 1px),
        $_boundary var(--_grid-gutter),
        transparent var(--_grid-gutter)
      ),
      linear-gradient(
        to left,
        transparent calc(var(--_grid-gutter) - 1px),
        $_boundary calc(var(--_grid-gutter) - 1px),
        $_boundary var(--_grid-gutter),
        transparent var(--_grid-gutter)
      );
  }
}
